exposure: Gestational diabetes risk groups based on GCT and OGTT results (GCT-negative - RG0, GCT-positive but OGTT normal - RG1, single abnormal value on OGTT or raised HbA1c - RG2, diagnosed GD - RG3)
cohort: A total of 1041 pregnant women were enrolled early during pregnancy and followed till delivery, undergoing the ACOG-recommended two-step procedure for GD diagnosis.
finding: The study identified a subgroup (RG2: single abnormal value on OGTT or raised HbA1c) at high risk of GD, with perinatal outcomes consistent with that of diagnosed GD.
mod_finding: Compared to GCT-negative women (RG0), RG2 showed a higher likelihood of primary cesarean section and any adverse outcome with cesarean section.
